name: Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

env:
  NODE_VERSION: 26.2.0
  NPM_VERSION: 11.15.0
  BUN_VERSION: 1.3.13

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: ${{ env.BUN_VERSION }}
      - run: bun ci
      - run: bun run typecheck
      - run: bun run lint
      - run: bun run format:check
      - run: bun run test

  publish-npm:
    name: Publish NPM
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: Publish
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: ${{ env.BUN_VERSION }}
      - name: Install npm
        run: npm install --global npm@${{ env.NPM_VERSION }}
      - name: Verify release toolchain
        run: |
          node --version
          npm --version
          npm stage --help
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun ci
      - name: Stage package on NPM
        run: npm stage publish --provenance
